classes.name: Sumika
classes.description: The habitat: a local daemon and CLI that own interactive PTY sessions so they outlive the terminal window. The terminal is a client, not the process owner.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: A named child process {name, argv, cwd} living in a PTY owned by Sumika. Not a pane, tab, kind, or headless run.

classes.name: Attach
classes.description: The exclusive focused client of one Session. Bytes are a raw PTY. A second Attach steals. Detach leaves the child.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: A hook-originated attention signal for a Session: idle, blocked, or running. Absence is unknown. Not a screen scrape.

classes.name: ResumeHint
classes.description: Optional opaque vendor chat identity stored on a Session only when a confirmed Stop payload provides an id and a confirmed resume-by-id flag exists. Not a Session. Sumika never invents it.

relations.name: runs_in
relations.description: A Session lives in Sumika. Sumika owns the process; the terminal does not.

relations.name: focuses
relations.description: An Attach is the exclusive focused client of one Session. A new Attach steals.

relations.name: updates
relations.description: A Report updates a Session's attention status. It does not parse the PTY.

relations.name: optionally_stores
relations.description: A Session may store one ResumeHint. The hint is not the Session. Absence means restart argv only.
